justification: Frontend config-only change: adds 4 council config JSON files and registers them in loader + council-config. No DB changes, no API changes. Standard because user-visible (DCP tab navigation, labels, topic grouping).

pre_impl.existing_data: These 4 councils already have provisions in regulatory_provisions (CoS 626, KRG 264, Waverley 304, Woollahra 350) and structured controls in dcp_setback_controls. They render in the DCP tab without configs — configs improve navigation.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If universalPartKeys or devTypeGatedPartKeys don't match actual v2_dcp_part values, chapter filtering may hide provisions. Mitigated: part keys derived from actual DB query of v2_dcp_part values.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Config-only — no data changes. Existing provisions render unchanged; configs add labels, topic grouping, DCP explanation text.

functions.name: COUNCIL_CONFIGS (council-config.ts:181)
functions.input: 4 new JSON imports cast as CouncilConfig

functions.name: BUNDLED_CONFIGS (loader.ts:26)
functions.input: 4 new JSON imports cast as CouncilConfig

values.if_missing: Falls back to defaults (tocTopLevelTerm='part'). Provisions still render.

values.guard_at: TocSidebar.tsx:148 — ternary chain with fallback to generic label

queries.purpose: No new DB queries — config is static JSON. Existing provision query uses document_id ILIKE pattern from COUNCIL_DOC_PATTERNS.
queries.if_zero: No provisions returned — DcpStructuredControls + DCPInterestForm shown
queries.if_wrong: COUNCIL_DOC_PATTERNS already handles city_of_sydney→Sydney_DCP and ku_ring_gai→Ku-ring-gai_DCP

break_it.scenario: universalPartKeys contain part keys that don't exist in DB v2_dcp_part
break_it.what_happens: Chapter marked universal but has no provisions — shows as empty chapter in TOC. Not harmful, just noisy.
break_it.how: Part keys derived from actual DB query of v2_dcp_part values for each council. Verified against live data.

break_it.scenario: Config JSON has invalid field — breaks TypeScript cast
break_it.what_happens: TSC error at build time, Vercel deploy fails
break_it.how: npx tsc --noEmit passes with 664 errors (unchanged baseline). All 4 configs type-checked.

break_it.scenario: COUNCIL_ALIASES maps 'sydney' to 'city_of_sydney' but formerCouncil from API is 'City of Sydney' (mixed case with spaces)
break_it.what_happens: detectCouncil may not match — falls back to null config
break_it.how: council-config.ts:204 lowercases and trims. COUNCIL_CONFIGS lookup at ProvisionsByTocStructure.tsx:348 also lowercases. Alias 'sydney' catches the Planning Portal's value.

post_merge.manual_verify: Load /assessment with addresses in Waverley, Woollahra, City of Sydney, Ku-ring-gai. Verify DCP tab shows provisions with TOC sidebar, correct DCP name, and structured controls.
